decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system fits the firm's core office and conference business, supports the trend toward flexible workplaces, and its dedicated product page signals clear strategic commitment.
A chair family is a core furniture category for this firm, complements multiple interior solutions, and the standalone web presentation suggests it is an important part of the range.

The floor cushions extend the firm's premium interior concept into softer lounge-oriented living spaces and their own page indicates management sees them as a deliberate design offering rather than a short-lived experiment.

Although sofas are close to the established offer, this product had only a website mention rather than a full presentation, which suggests weaker strategic priority and makes it a likely candidate for portfolio pruning.
The high standing table matches the firm's push toward adaptable contemporary work environments and was given its own page, both of which support retaining it.

Even though the rug collection is more distant from the traditional furniture core, it strengthens the firm's full interior-solution positioning and premium material story, and the dedicated webpage indicates active support.
